title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
summary: Sergey Ioffe and Christian Szegedy submitted Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift on February 11, 2015. The paper proposed normalizing layer inputs as part of the model architecture using statistics computed for each training mini-batch, and reported that the method enabled higher learning rates and reduced sensitivity to initialization.
significance: A documented deep-learning optimization and normalization milestone introducing Batch Normalization as an architectural training method.

verification.note: The original arXiv record identifies the authors, February 11 2015 submission date, and the method of normalizing layer inputs for each training mini-batch. The official PMLR ICML 2015 proceedings independently corroborate the authors, title, method description and 2015 conference publication.
